newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares rebound on institutional demand.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares rebound on institutional demand.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index rebounded strongly on institutional buying on Thursday after Wednesday's plunge, rising 7.00 percent on the day, brokers said.
The B index was up 8.86 points to close at 135.46 on turnover of HK$231.16 million, compared with HK$241.08 million turnover on Wednesday.
All the 43 Shenzhen-listed B counters gained. Brokers said the index was boosted by institutional buying of large-cap issues due to the absence of negative news.
They said the rise could be viewed as a technical rebound due to the sharp decline the previous session.
The recent surges had attracted a flood of cash, which is unlikely to leave the market in the short term unless Beijing makes an announcement which has a negative impact, one broker said.
Dadonghai, the day's star, soared HK$0.41, or 14.39 percent, to HK$3.26 on active trade of 5.10 million shares due to institutional demand, brokers said.
SEZ Real Estate gained HK$0.59, or 13.32 percent, to HK$5.02 on volume of 2.05 million shares.
Television tube maker SEG, Wednesday's worst performer, rallied HK$0.49, or 12.89 percent, to HK$4.29 after 1.64 million shares changed hands.
Changan Automobile rebounded HK$0.36 to HK$3.35 on the session's heaviest trade of 13.09 million shares.
Conglomerate Zhonghao advanced HK$0.46 to HK$4.30, with 427,320 shares traded.
The A market maintained its downward trend, with investors believing a correction had started following the recent bull run, brokers said.

The A index slipped 1.96 points, or 0.44 percent, to end at 442.70 on turnover of 9.61 billion yuan, compared with Wednesday's 11.09 billion yuan. The composite index dipped 0.60 points, or 0.14 percent, to 416.25.
Huatian Hotel, which had gained heavily recently, fell 2.72 yuan, or 11.98 percent, to 19.98 yuan.
Chemical fibre producer Hainan Sea Rainbow sank 0.51 yuan, or 4.46 percent, to 10.93 yuan.
